name: Liberia
alt: American Colonization Society settlement at Cape Mesurado

ledger.x: 1822: American Colonization Society settlers found Liberia at Cape Mesurado.
1839: the settlements are reorganised as the Commonwealth of Liberia, with Monrovia as capital.
By 1842: the settlements of the other state colonization societies are merged into Liberia.
ledger.cp: the other colonization societies' colonies (Kentucky-in-Africa, Mississippi in Africa, Louisiana and Pennsylvania settlements)

ledger.x: 1847, 26 July: Liberia declares its independence as a republic.
1857, 18 March: Liberia annexes the Republic of Maryland.
1892, 8 December: the Franco-Liberian treaty fixes the frontier with French Ivory Coast on the Cavalla River.
1903, June: the Anglo-Liberian boundary is extended northwards, apparently giving Liberia the Parrot's Beak area.
1907, 18 September: a second Franco-Liberian treaty moves the northern frontier south to its present line.
1911, January: Liberia cedes the Parrot's Beak area to Sierra Leone.
1980, 12 April: Master Sergeant Samuel Doe's coup overthrows and kills President Tolbert.

wars.name: Grebo and Kru insurgency against the Republic of Maryland
wars.outcome: The Republic of Maryland 'was forced by an insurgency of the Grebo and the Kru people to join Liberia'; the Liberian infobox gives the annexation as 18 March 1857.

wars.name: First Liberian Civil War
wars.outcome: A rebel group 'launched an insurrection in December 1989 against Doe's government'; 'By September 1990, Doe's forces controlled only a small area' and Doe was captured and executed that month; Charles Taylor was elected president in 1997.

wars.name: Second Liberian Civil War
wars.outcome: Taylor resigned in August 2003 and went into exile in Nigeria; the 2005 elections followed.

certainty.note: Coastal settlements with a claimed hinterland, Cape Mesurado was acquired from King Peter (History of Liberia); no survey or treaty frontier with a European power.
